question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(AB=AC\), and \(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\). Find the measure of \(\angle ADB\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: By SSS, \(\triangle ABD\cong\triangle ACD\), so \(\angle ADB=\angle ADC\). Also, \(\angle ADB+\angle ADC=180^\circ\), hence \(\angle ADB=90^\circ\).
solutions.title: SSS and equal supplementary angles

solutions.explanation: Since \(AB=AC\), the triangle is isosceles with base \(BC\). Because \(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\), \(AD\) is the median to the base. In an isosceles triangle, this median is also an altitude, so \(AD\perp BC\). Therefore \(\angle ADB=90^\circ\).
solutions.title: Use the isosceles median property
